verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships a documented official CLI, installed via `uv tool install crewai`, that can create, train, run, test, and manage crews, flows, tools, skills, and templates. The docs also cover command deprecations, and the install page provides a setup prompt that has coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) install the official skills and check the CLI, which fits the AI-native workflow. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage, since all evidence is vendor docs plus a probe confirming the CLI page exists.
